Our equipment is built around stackable, modular frames (1000mm × 500mm × 500mm, L × W × H) that form vertical towers for compact, scalable food production. Crafted from lightweight, self-healing nanomaterials for superior durability, each frame features plug-and-play slots for growing modules, such as hydroponic pods or aquaponic tanks, customized to your cultivation goals. Choose from three tower configurations to suit your space and yield requirements - start small and scale up effortlessly.

  • One Frame Tower - ideal for beginners or testing

    For 1-2 produce types (e.g., herbs or microgreens), yielding ~2-5kg/year. Height: 500mm.

  • Two Frame Tower - supports hybrid setups

    e.g., vegetables and small fish like tilapia, yielding ~5-10kg/year. Height: 1000mm.

  • Four Frame Tower - maximizes yield in minimal space

    Enables full ecosystems (e.g., aquaponics with mushrooms, snails, and greens), yielding ~10-20kg/year. Height: 2000mm.
